title: casearia guianensis
intro: Casearia guianensis, commonly known as the guiana casearia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Salicaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and as a digestive aid. The therapeutic actions of Casearia guianensis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
